title: Honest-Broker Custody, Two-Person Re-Identification & Server Workflows
text: dicomtk.server provides multi-user research server orchestration walled-honest-broker key custody clinical DICOM studies: 8-Role OIDC/Keycloak RBAC: pi, coordinator, annotator, auditor, admin, site_admin, honest_broker, dpo. SHA-256 Hash-Chained Audit Log: Every de-identification, re-ID request, approval, disclosure, QA review, job submission appended tamper-evident JSONL ledger. Walled-Custody Enclave: Master keys patient-identity crosswalks live inside isolated closure inaccessible pi non-broker roles. Two-Person Re-Identification: Requires distinct honest_broker dpo principals approve request time-limited disclosure.

title: Honest-Broker Custody, Two-Person Re-Identification & Server Workflows
code: library(dicomtk.server)  tmp_dir <- tempfile("dicomtk_vig_") ctx <- server_create_context(work_dir = tmp_dir, jwt_secret = "vignette-secret")  adm <- server_principal("adm-1", roles = "admin", project_ids = "*") pi <- server_principal("pi-1", roles = "pi", project_ids = "nsclc-01") hb <- server_principal("hb-1", roles = "honest_broker", project_ids = "*") dpo <- server_principal("dpo-1", roles = "dpo", project_ids = "*")  project_create(ctx$projects, "nsclc-01", title = "NSCLC Radiomics") #> $project_id #> [1] "nsclc-01" #>  #> $title #> [1] "NSCLC Radiomics" #>  #> $deid_profile #> [1] "ps3.15" #>  #> $custody_mode #> [1] "broker" #>  #> $created_at #> [1] "2026-11-14T15:22:17Z" project_list(ctx$projects) #> # A tibble: 1 × 5 #>   project_id title           deid_profile custody_mode created_at           #>   <chr>      <chr>           <chr>        <chr>        <chr>                #> 1 nsclc-01   NSCLC Radiomics ps3.15       broker       2026-11-14T15:22:17Z  # Verify audit chain integrity audit_verify(ctx$logger) #> $passed #> [1] TRUE #>  #> $n_entries #> [1] 0 #>  #> $corrupted_line #> [1] NA  unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

title: dicomtk.server 1.0.0
text: SMART FHIR v2 EHR-launch (smart_discover_config(), smart_pkce_challenge(), smart_build_auth_url(), smart_exchange_token(), smart_pull_patient_context()) RFC 7636 S256 PKCE, CSRF state validation, honest-broker enclave pseudonymisation. IHE AIW-UPS-RS workitem state machine (ihe_aiw_workitem(), ihe_aiw_transition()) IHE AIR conformance bundle (ihe_air_bundle()). Dual-gated SaMD clinical write-back (clinical_writeback_enabled(), clinical_writeback_execute()) requiring explicit server opt-, "clinical_writeback" RBAC permission, audit trail logging. CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM generator (server_generate_sbom()), 6-category STRIDE threat model (server_threat_model()), REST /sbom & /threat-model endpoints, non-root inst/docker/Dockerfile.

title: dicomtk.server 0.1.0
text: Eight-role OpenID Connect / Keycloak RBAC (pi, coordinator, annotator, auditor, admin, site_admin, honest_broker, dpo). Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL audit log (audit_logger(), audit_append(), audit_verify()). Walled-broker custody enclave (broker_enclave_init(), broker_deid_study()) pi provably read key material. Two-person (honest_broker + dpo) time-limited re-identification workflow (reid_request(), reid_approve(), reid_disclose()). mirai async job queue, 3D segmentation QA (compute_seg_qa() Dice, HD95, surface_dice), MONAI Label active learning, event-driven routing, plumber / shiny interfaces.
